B1_vanilla.label: B1 vanilla (LLM self-abstention only)
B1_vanilla.notes: Answers everything the LLM answers; confidence = normalised top-1 cosine.

B1_empty_filter.label: B1 + empty-reply filter
B1_empty_filter.notes: Refuses drafts with no content besides citation markers; no threshold.

B2_grounding_only.label: B2 grounding only (no thresholds)
B2_grounding_only.notes: Full confidence score reported, no abstention thresholds.

TriSafe_rrf.label: TriSafe-RAG with raw RRF retrieval signal
TriSafe_rrf.notes: Legacy retrieval signal; shows the effect of the near-constant RRF scale.

Gate_confidence.label: Gate: confidence thresholds only
Gate_confidence.notes: tau_ans and tau_ref at default; grounding and citation gates off.

Gate_grounding.label: Gate: grounding support only
Gate_grounding.notes: tau_g at default; confidence and citation gates off.

Gate_citation.label: Gate: citation coverage only
Gate_citation.notes: tau_c at default; confidence and grounding gates off.

TriSafe_nolang.label: TriSafe-RAG without the language-match signal
TriSafe_nolang.notes: w_lang = 0; other weights renormalised to sum to 1.

TriSafe_empty.label: TriSafe-RAG (dev-tuned) + empty-reply filter
TriSafe_empty.notes: Dev-tuned thresholds plus the content check of B1_empty_filter.

TriSafe_perlang.label: TriSafe-RAG + per-language thresholds (dev)
TriSafe_perlang.notes: Fairness enforced by language-specific answer thresholds.

E3_platt.label: E3 Platt (logistic) on the five signals

E4_isotonic.label: E4 isotonic on the TriSafe sum

E5_temperature.label: E5 temperature scaling on the TriSafe sum
